books.title: Introduction to Space
books.tagline: Big, simple space pictures for the littlest explorers.
books.intro: Say hello to space with Zippy the star! Color 20 big, simple pictures: the Sun, the Moon, Earth, the planets, a rocket, an astronaut and a Mars rover. Thick, bold lines and big spaces are just right for little hands. See the real colors of space! Every page matches the coloring book, with a bright full-color picture, one or two short sentences to read aloud, a fun fact and a simple question.

books.title: Exploration of Space
books.tagline: Blast off with Zippy the star through the whole solar system.
books.intro: Blast off with Zippy the star! Color 22 big space pictures, from the blazing Sun and ringed Saturn to rockets, astronauts and a Mars rover. Every page has a short, true fact written for kids in kindergarten to 2nd grade and checked against NASA sources.

books.title: Constellations
books.tagline: Real star patterns, star stories and puzzles for young sky-watchers.
books.intro: Twenty famous constellations, each drawn over its real stars as they look from a real place on a real night. The coloring and activity book adds crosswords, word searches, a secret star message, a maze and four seasonal star maps. The full-color companion book tells the star stories and the science behind them.
